text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...――

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: So this is... an actual race—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Good work!" "That was a great run~!!"
"Congrats on your debut!!"
"Keep giving it your all from here on out!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: The voices of the crowd—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(There's only a scattered few right now,
but all of those people are celebrating
us making our debut today—)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...♪
That's so super lovey...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...I hope this excitement
reaches everyone too――

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, I'm so glad I came to the track~~……!
"Debut race was amazing~!" and…… send!

text_block_list.name: Hardworker@Overseas Assignment
text_block_list.text:
""She finally debuted, huh...
Man, I'm actually tearing up...!""

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"So moving!" "The start of a legend!"
"Everyone feels like proud parents lol" "My heart was racing~"
"Great job!" "Nice race! ↑↑"

Returning after her debut race,
Loves Only You still seemed to be
buzzing with excitement――

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer-kun!
The race wrapped up without a hitch, so can we change spots and start streaming right away?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer-chan!
The race wrapped up without a hitch, so can we change spots and start streaming right away?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I'm just so anxious to know
whether everyone watched it or not...!"
choice_data_list: Are you feeling okay? Not too tired?
Are you feeling okay? Not too tired?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, no problem at all!
In fact, doing a stream will probably blow all my fatigue away!

And so, after packing up to head home,
we decided on the spot to do a quick livestream nearby—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Love me♡ Love you♡
It's Loves Only You♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
My debut race is officially in the books!
And I just couldn't wait until I got home,
so I started streaming right away—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Did everyone see my run~?

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
" 'I saw it!' 'Good work~!' 'I'm so moved!'
'That was so cool!' 'The best!!'
'Thanks for the instant stream~!' 'Gg!' "

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Waah, amazing...!
There's already so many...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you all for the support.
Thanks to you, it was the best debut race I could ask for♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I'll keep running with all the love in my heart
to answer everyone's love from now on, too.
So ne~ver take your eyes off me, okay?♡"

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Always rooting for you♪" "Do your best!"
"Looking forward to what's next!" "What's the next goal!?"
"Look how much she's grown!" "So excited!★"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"‘What is your next goal?’, huh.
...Yeah, I really need to decide soon, don't I?♪"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun.
Spill! Where are we aiming for next?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer-chan.
Tell me straight! Where are we aiming next?"
I was a bit surprised when she brought it up out of the blue, but I had already organized my thoughts on future goals.
I was planning to check in with her later today, but sharing it on stream like this might motivate her even more...!
choice_data_list: Let's aim for the Classic races!

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Ooooh!" "It's here!" "For real?!"
"What's a Classic race?" "Such big dreams~!"
"Bridge really aims high!" "Cheering for you↑↑↑"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! I know, right!
It's so full of wonder...!!
I was totally blown away just now too!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
âAh, but it seems there are some among you
who are hearing the term 'Classic Races'
for the very first time...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: All right, then let me explain a little bit about the Classic races♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Having just debuted, I'm currently in the Junior Class, but starting next January, I'll be considered part of the Classic Class.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And Classic races are filled with tradition, glory,
and love, where only Classic-class Umamusume
are allowed to run!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure many of you have heard of
the Nippon Derby, right?
Along with that, there's the Satsuki Sho, the Kikuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: The Oka Sho and the Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks)! These five are the so-called Classic races, the stage where the absolute elite Umamusume of their generation gather♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And so, the route made up of the Satsuki Sho,
Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby), and Kikuka Sho
is what's known as the "Classic Triple Crown"—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: The Oka Sho and the Oaks. Add the Shuka Sho to those two, and you get what's known as the 'Triple Tiara' route♪

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for the breakdown!" "Big help!"
"Hmm, I see" "This is great review"
"This'll be on the test!" "Understood!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"When it comes to running in Classic races,
you generally have to choose
between one of these two routes, but—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Now then! Trainer-kun, which path did you have in mind for me?
choice_data_list: Whichever route you want to run is fine by me.
Whichever path you want to run, either is fine.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Now then! Trainer-chan, which path did you have in mind for me?
choice_data_list: Whichever route you want to run is fine by me.
Whichever path you want to run, either is fine.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Really?
In that case, I'll—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I want to go down the Tiara route...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I want to run in the Oka Sho, the Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks), and the Shuka Sho...!
choice_data_list: Do you have a particular preference?
Do you have a particular preference?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yes♪ You see, I—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I felt a profound "love"
for all the Tiara Umamusume throughout history...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Dainty, gorgeous, powerful,
sharp, cool, beautiful... ♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I think if I could run with that kind of "love" too,
I could become totally and utterly love-filled♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So if I'm going to run in the Classic races,
I want to aim for the Triple Tiara...!

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"So cool~!" "Agreed!!"
"I think a tiara would look great on you!"
"Totally Lovely!" "I wanna see it too!"
choice_data_list: Then it's settled! Let's aim for the Tiara route!
Then it's settled! Let's aim for the Tiara route!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Everyone... Trainer-kun...—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Everyone... Trainer-chan...—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...I won't let you down.
I'll live up to all the expectations everyone just gave me!
And so, together with Loves Only You, we set a new goal in front of everyone in the community—
—On the way back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer-kun.
Thank you so much for today."
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-chan.
Thank you so much for today.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"During the stream,
when Trainer-kun looked at me and said,
'Let's aim for the Classic races'—his eyes..."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"During the stream,
when Trainer-chan looked at me and said,
'Let's aim for the Classic races'—her eyes..."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
She looked straight at me...
and I felt such a sincere love.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Toward my... future.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Because look, you can't just easily say,
'You can run in the Classic races!'
now, can you?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Because look, you can't just easily say,
'You can run in the Classic races!'
now, can you?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I know full well. A once-in-a-lifetime, supreme stage
that only a tiny handful of Umamusume get to run on.
That's what the Classic races are.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...That's precisely why I was so happy.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...the fact that you believed in me as a horse girl who could run in Classic races.
choice_data_list: Because we made a promise, right?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: The fact that you believe I'm an Umamusume who can run in the Classic races.
choice_data_list: Because we made a promise, right?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: A promise?
choice_data_list: That I'd take you to the world stage.
I promised I'd take you to the world.

text_block_list.text:
"...Her sights are set on the world.
To spread her wings and fly there,
she needs a solid track record at home."
"That is the glorious stage where only ultra-first-rate Umamusume are permitted to run. One must have the achievements worthy of racing in the Classics."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...That trust of yours.
I have to properly live up to it, don't I?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...That trust you have in me.
I have to live up to it with everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
All the commu-members have
such high hopes for me, too—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer-kun.
Do you remember that video shoot from the other day?"
choice_data_list: You mean the photo we took with Gran Alegria and the others?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-chan.
Do you remember that video shoot from the other day?
choice_data_list: You mean the photo we took with Gran Alegria and the others?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Right. Gran-chan, Chrono-chan, Bouquet-chan,
who were all there back then.
You know they're all in my generation, right?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...To tell the truth, I heard everyone
is aiming for the Tiara route."
choice_data_list: I see...!
I see...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Just like how I dream of spreading my wings to the world someday,
everyone has their own dreams too, but—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Everyone debuted before me and has already started walking their own paths.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: We might be in the same class, but... there's already a gap between us from everything they've built up—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Because we're so close, I can just tell.
They're all such amazingly talented Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So that I can compete in the Classic races with everyone who's just a step ahead of me—
I have to work desperately to catch up!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's build up our strength for that as well!
Yeah, so let's build up our strength for that too!

text_block_list.text: "First and foremost, we need to build a body capable of handling Classic races, and gain live race experience in parallel."
"For that reason, during the Junior Year, I want to avoid setting goals for specific races and plan her entries while observing her growth...!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I think so too!
I'm in favor of that approach♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu♪
I need you watching my growth up close
at all times, Trainer-kun♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu♪
I need you to watch my growth up close all the time, Trainer-chan♡
And so, our days of Junior-class training with an eye toward the Classics began...!
